format: NDCA Pro/Am student events (Newcomer, winner rules)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: A Newcomer division is open for one year from the first NDCA event and is closed syllabus only; a winner of a qualifying closed or rising-star multi-dance event cannot re-enter the same level, style and age at that event in later years; organizers may be stricter. Multi-level guidance is advisory.

requirement: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Competition OS does not read, store or verify this requirement. For initial activation the organizer determines Studio/Custom eligibility and records the decision (OD-18 Option A); DanceFlow does not verify body registration, membership, Points Registry data or proficiency points. Future design only: see the credential-capture design note in the OD-18 PR.
enforcement_point: None for the body rule itself. The organizer determination gate (evaluateEntryOperationalGate, updateCompetitionEntryEligibilityAction) records that the organizer verified applicable criteria; it does not evaluate this rule.

tests.name: says Studio/Custom eligibility is determined by the organizer and never claims body-credential verification

interpretation_notes: OD-18 (2026-11-23): organizer verification now; automated verified rule evaluation is a future, separately reviewed phase for NDCA/UCWDC/WSDC body profiles. The effective date is the edition month; an exact effective date is NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE. Sub-rule II.B.7.e is guidance, not mandatory.
